This product includes a modified copy of rPGP 0.21.0.
Upstream: https://github.com/rpgp/rpgp
Source revision: c2b192e52b2e7f99777196539ea79b37f1f9ff30
Authors: the rPGP contributors, including dignifiedquire.
Upstream license: MIT OR Apache-2.0. This copy may be used under the MIT license.

Sanct removed RSA, ECDSA, NIST ECDH, Ed448, X448 and optional OpenPGP PQC
providers and their dependencies. These algorithms are unavailable in this build.
Source comments, upstream test code, examples and benchmarks were omitted.
The remaining Curve25519 cryptographic implementations are derived from rPGP.
The complete upstream license texts accompany this notice.
